content: Which adjuster has the most open claims, and what is their total outstanding reserve?
Adjuster probably means the case Owner. I'll group by Owner.

name: query_salesforce

content:
**You own all 26 open claims**, so you have the most. Their total outstanding reserve is **$1,077,075**.

I counted the claim owner as the adjuster, since claims don't have a separate adjuster field. Every open claim is assigned to you, so there's no one to compare you with. If your team records the handling adjuster somewhere else, such as in file note authors, I can break the claims down that way instead.
